infra-up.template: Run `docker compose up -d`, then run `docker ps` and confirm both the postgres and redis containers show as healthy. Report the result plainly.
infra-up.description: Start Postgres and Redis containers and confirm they're healthy

infra-down.template: Run `docker compose down` to stop the Postgres and Redis containers. Confirm they've stopped.

backend-run.template: Run the Spring Boot backend with `cd backend && mvn spring-boot:run`, and report whether it boots cleanly or show me the first error if it doesn't.

backend-build.template: Run `cd backend && mvn clean compile` and report any compile errors, without starting the server.
backend-build.description: Compile the backend only, surface errors

frontend-run.template: Run the Angular dev server with `cd frontend && ng serve` and confirm it's serving on http://localhost:4200.

db-inspect.template: Run `docker exec -it transactionguard-postgres psql -U tg_user -d transactionguard -c "\dt"` and show me the list of tables that currently exist.
